parameters.name: name
parameters.label: HMM profile name (-n)
parameters.help_text: Name the HMM profile.

parameters.name: informat
parameters.label: Input alignment format (--informat)
parameters.help_text: Force input MSA format instead of autodetecting.

parameters.name: alphabet
parameters.label: Alphabet
parameters.help_text: HMMER auto-guesses the alphabet from the input alignment. Force when guess is wrong.

parameters.name: architecture
parameters.label: Model construction strategy

options.label: --hand · Use reference annotation from MSA (#=GC RF)

parameters.help_text: --fast assigns columns as match states automatically; --hand requires #=GC RF annotation in the input alignment.

parameters.name: symfrac
parameters.label: Match-column symbol fraction (--symfrac)
parameters.help_text: Columns with >= this fraction of non-gap residues become match states.

parameters.name: fragthresh
parameters.label: Fragment threshold (--fragthresh)
parameters.help_text: Sequences shorter than (this × alignment length) are flagged as fragments.

options.label: --wgiven · Use weights as given in MSA file

parameters.name: wid
parameters.label: BLOSUM identity cutoff (--wid)
parameters.help_text: Identity threshold used by --wblosum filter weights.

parameters.name: effective_weighting
parameters.label: Effective sequence weighting strategy
parameters.help_text: Pick how HMMER computes the 'effective' number of sequences. To set the number explicitly use --eset below.

parameters.name: eset
parameters.label: Override: set effective sequence number (--eset)
parameters.help_text: Override the strategy above and force this effective N. HMMER rejects --eset together with explicit --eclust or --enone, so use it only with the default --eent strategy.

parameters.name: ere
parameters.label: Minimum relative entropy per position (--ere)
parameters.help_text: Only used with --eent. Leave blank for HMMER's alphabet-dependent default (0.59 protein / 0.45 nucleotide).

parameters.name: esigma
parameters.label: Sigma for --eent (--esigma)
parameters.help_text: Smoothing parameter for the entropy-targeting calculation.

parameters.name: singlemx_mode
parameters.label: Substitution matrix scoring for single-sequence input
parameters.help_text: Only meaningful when the input alignment contains a single sequence.

parameters.name: mx_source
parameters.label: Matrix source
parameters.help_text: Pick one. --mx and --mxfile are mutually exclusive.

parameters.name: mx
parameters.label: Built-in substitution matrix (--mx)
parameters.help_text: Pick a built-in matrix. Leave blank for HMMER's default (BLOSUM62 / DNA1).

parameters.name: mxfile
parameters.label: Custom substitution matrix file (--mxfile)
parameters.help_text: Upload a BLAST/FASTA-format substitution matrix. Square matrices only.

parameters.name: popen
parameters.label: Gap open probability (--popen)
parameters.help_text: Override gap-open probability with --singlemx. Default 0.02 (protein), 0.031 (nucleic). HMMER requires 0 <= x < 0.5.

parameters.name: pextend
parameters.label: Gap extend probability (--pextend)
parameters.help_text: Override gap-extend probability with --singlemx. Default 0.4 (protein), 0.75 (nucleic). HMMER requires 0 <= x < 1.

parameters.name: EmL
parameters.label: MSV-filter calibration: sequence length (--EmL)
parameters.help_text: Expert: length of simulated sequences used to estimate MSV-filter mu.

parameters.name: EmN
parameters.label: MSV-filter calibration: # sequences (--EmN)
parameters.help_text: Expert: number of simulated sequences for MSV mu estimation.

parameters.name: Eft
parameters.label: Forward calibration: tail mass (--Eft)
parameters.help_text: Tail mass fraction used in Forward tau fit. HMMER requires 0 < x < 1.

parameters.name: w_beta
parameters.label: Window length tail mass (--w_beta)
parameters.help_text: Upper bound W is set such that fraction of sequences >= W is < this. Default 1e-7.

parameters.name: w_length
parameters.label: Override window length (--w_length)
parameters.help_text: Hard upper bound on instance length W. Must be greater than model length.

parameters.name: maxinsertlen
parameters.label: Maximum expected insert length (--maxinsertlen)
parameters.help_text: Restrict insert length parameterisation so expected insert length at each position is no more than this. HMMER requires n >= 5.

parameters.name: seed
parameters.label: Random seed (--seed)
parameters.help_text: Use 0 for a non-deterministic, arbitrary seed.

parameters.name: cpu
parameters.label: Parallel CPU workers (--cpu)
parameters.help_text: Number of parallel worker threads. Server defaults to 2.
